notes: Rebuttal Overall bars are generated by hacmo/overall/scripts/run_overall_rebuttal.py.
Primary metrics are decode-only TPOT/TPS. TPOT is full decode-stage service time per output token at the stated B/worker; TPS is global_batch / TPOT_seconds.
The prefill/context panel is a pipeline-derived prefill proxy, not true TTFT.
Dense-attention models do not receive HACMO's DSA cache/prefetch benefit.
Dense decode attention uses overall_dense_decode_attention_hbm_stream rather than the TP1 sparse-attention wafer-core NoC proxy.
Qwen3 and Llama4 bars use model-specific TP2/TP3 packs built from local HF expert-selection traces with a 160-request epoch-t telemetry window and a 280-request held-out epoch-t+1 evaluation window.
Overall requires TP2/TP3 MoE inputs to represent one representative MoE layer; validators reject all-layer aggregates by checking expert_counts/tokens_per_die against model top-k.
GPU DGX/NVL72 MoE rows replay the same TP2 runtime artifacts with DGX/NVL72 ASTRA network configs; they do not use synthetic routing.

GPU replay scale and decode-step range are derived from the staged TP2 runtime inputs, not read from pack metadata, and are recorded per row in run_metadata.json gpu_replay_contracts. A missing runtime artifact is a hard error rather than a fallback to the LS vLLM row.

All rows share one per-die substrate and differ only in interconnect fabric, so dense decode attention charges the KV injection/NoC term on every row including GPU; only HACMO reduces it via the TP1 static-mapping hop credit.

GPU fabric is modeled as a one-dimensional equivalent flat switch because the ASTRA congestion-aware backend supports one-dimensional standard topologies. Hierarchical intra-node NVLink plus NCCL aggregation is not modeled; the effective bandwidth/latency figures stand in for the cross-node all-to-all bottleneck.
MoEntwine uses TP2 moentwine_static/NI-Balancer-style shadow-replica rows. Attention remains naive; no fixed paper multiplier is applied.

WaferLLM uses vLLM MoE placement and dispatch/combine communication plus HACMO-side waferllm_matrix_model_hacmo_reproduction for matrix stages. It does not receive HACMO placement or crossbar credit, and prefill rows include attention-weight HBM streaming.
HACMO combines current TP1 DeepSeek sparse-attention evidence, TP2 dynamic MoE mapping, and TP3 lane-level crossbar allocation.
Validators check source provenance and metric semantics rather than enforcing expected winners or minimum speedups.

sources.MoEntwine: TP2 moentwine_static implementation under hacmo/moe; paper mechanism represented as runtime-load shadow replicas / NI-Balancer-style baseline in the TP2 pipeline.
sources.WaferLLM: HACMO-side waferllm_matrix_model_hacmo_reproduction for MeshGEMV/MeshGEMM-style matrix execution on the same Layered Supernode substrate; official Cerebras simulator is not executable locally.
sources.DeepSeek_V3_2: Current TP1 sparse-attention pack plus DeepSeek-style TP2/TP3 MoE packs.
sources.Qwen3_235B_A22B_FP8: ModelScope config.json and model-specific TP2/TP3 overall packs from local traces; Qwen3 TP2 uses the epoch-t telemetry base plus static library with held-out epoch-t+1 evaluation.
sources.Llama4_Maverick_17B_128E_Instruct: ModelScope config.json and model-specific TP2/TP3 overall packs from local traces; Llama4 uses static-library selection from epoch-t telemetry and held-out epoch-t+1 evaluation.
